text: 1955 changes the sourceDocument argument to browsingContext.window?.document. Current Save Link and Save Image both use that optional local-window access. Preserve absence of a local window for remote content; the fix does not grant access to a remote document or prove all saveURL parameters are optional. The system principal and other arguments remain explicit in this call. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: A browser context can have no local window document when saving a link
